callees.name: extract_spec_block
callees.pre_condition: file_path is a Path object pointing to an extracted function file on disk.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict with 'signature', 'pre_condition', and 'post_condition' keys describing the function's behavioral contract, or None when no valid specification sidecar exists for that file.

callees.name: extract_info_block
callees.pre_condition: file_path is a Path object pointing to an extracted function file on disk.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict with a 'callees' key containing callee expectation entries, or None when no valid info sidecar exists for that file.

callees.name: extract_callee_spec_from_info
callees.pre_condition: info_dict is a dict with a 'callees' key; callee_fqn is a fully-qualified function name string; aliases is an iterable of alias name strings.
callees.post_condition: Returns the callee entry dict from info_dict['callees'] whose name matches callee_fqn or any string in aliases. Returns None when no entry matches any of those identifiers.
